page.overview:
What is VR Springtrap?

(simply referred to as Springtrap in the story) is a smaller version of Springtrap who was originated from a video game known as Springtrap's Revenge. He is the main antagonist of In the Flesh, the second story in Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call.

Much like his game counterpart, VR Springtrap is a large green rabbit with the better part of one ear missing. Unlike his game counterpart, VR Springtrap doesn't contain the corpse of William Afton. Instead, his tattered costume reveals mechanical parts underneath the fabric. VR Springtrap has a wide grin, a tongue, and eyes that glow green when he spots the player.

When Springtrap emerges from Matt’s body in the real world, he is wet and slimy with mucus and the size of a healthy, newborn infant. He is also more organic than the one in the video game.

Despite being very similar to Springtrap from the games, VR Springtrap has a different origin. According to Matt, his design was inspired by his fear of people wearing animal mascot costumes, as one of his earliest fears was inspired from a Mall Easter Bunny that his mother took a picture of him with when he was young. VR Springtrap's murderous nature was inspired by horror movies and real-world serial killers, as Matt wanted to immortalize him as a terrifying character.
